verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a set of Claude Code skills (slash commands and SKILL.md files) plus local standard-library Python scripts. It has no UI of its own and no product API, so UI-to-API parity is a category error for this kind of tool. The API mentioned in the evidence is one the skill plans for the user's clone app, not an API of replica-skill itself, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
